index-1.state: Bob is signed in; a few documents exist so My work is not empty.
callouts: The left navigation: **Library**, **Templates**, **Approvals** and the other staff pages.
The **My work** page, which lists what is waiting on the signed-in person.

signing-in-1.state: Nobody signed in. The Dev quick login lists only the eight test people.
callouts: The **Dev quick login** box under the sign-in form, marked DEV. It is only in the mock, development and testing builds, never in a production Steward.
The dropdown with the placeholder **Sign in as a test user**.
The username and password form. You do not need it.

signing-in-2.state: Nobody signed in to the admin app.
callouts: The **Admin** tag on the sign-in page.
The same **Dev quick login** dropdown (only in the mock, development and testing builds).

policies-and-procedures-1.state: The Library has documents in several categories.
callouts: The **Library** item in the left navigation.
The **New policy** button. Procedures have their own **Library**, with **New procedure**.
The list of documents. A category with nothing in it says "No policies match these filters".

policies-and-procedures-2.state: A category with a default, unlocked template (Standard Policy) is chosen. The form is open, nothing created.
policies-and-procedures-2.clicks: Library, New policy, choose a category.
callouts: The **Category** box. Some categories only hold other categories, or only policies, or only procedures; the form tells you if your choice cannot hold the document.
The **Template** box. **No template (freeform)** gives you a blank document.
The text "Set by the category: authors use this template." when the template is locked.

policies-and-procedures-3.state: {draft}: a Standard Policy draft of Bob's with two sections written and one required section empty; AI simulation on.
policies-and-procedures-3.clicks: Create a policy from Standard Policy, type a few lines.
callouts: The document area. Start writing, or press `/` for blocks.
The **Actions** menu, which holds the AI items, **Withdraw from review** and **Discard draft**.

policies-and-procedures-4.state: {draft} with AI simulation on; the AI menu is open and the review sheet shows a Blocker, a Warning and a Note.
policies-and-procedures-4.clicks: Open the draft, click AI, Review draft.
callouts: The **AI review** sheet. Findings are marked **Blocker**, **Warning** or **Note**, and each says it is simulated.
The **Jump to** links that take you to the section.

policies-and-procedures-5.state: {ready}: a draft of Bob's with every required section filled, in a category that has a workflow. Submit dialog open, not confirmed.
policies-and-procedures-5.clicks: Fill every required section, click Submit for approval (do not confirm).
callouts: The document and the workflow it goes to.
The version block with **Major**, **Minor** and **Fix**. It appears for a revision of a published document.

policies-and-procedures-6.state: {inReview}: Bob's document in review at stage 1 of 2. Actions menu open, Withdraw dialog open, not confirmed.

policies-and-procedures-7.state: Bob has several drafts: one in draft, one in review, one a revision of a published document.
callouts: **My drafts**, the page you are on.
The list of drafts, with the document number, title and when it was updated.

approvals-1.state: Charlie has pending, in-progress and coming-to-you items.
callouts: **Approvals** in the left navigation, with a count of what is waiting.
The **Pending** list: drafts waiting for your decision.
**Coming to you**: later stages where you are an approver. Use **Preview**.

approvals-2.state: {inReview} awaiting Charlie; top of the page.
callouts: The approval flow bar: Submitted, each stage, Publish.
The tabs. **Proposed Publish** shows the document; a revision also has **Changes vs the current published version**.

approvals-3.state: {inReview}: text selected, comment box open with Suggest a change ticked. Not sent.
approvals-3.clicks: Select a phrase, click Comment, tick Suggest a change.
callouts: The **Suggested text** box ("The words to use instead").

approvals-4.state: {edited}: Bob edited after Charlie last looked, so the Changes since you last reviewed tab shows.
approvals-4.clicks: Needs Bob to edit after a first look, then reopen. Click Changes since you last reviewed.
callouts: The **Changes since you last reviewed** tab.
The changes: added text is underlined and green, removed text is struck through, with a count of each.

approvals-5.state: {rejected}: Charlie sent changes back; Bob opens the document and sees the status, comments and history.
approvals-5.clicks: After Charlie sent changes back, open the draft.
callouts: The note to address the feedback and submit again.
**Submit for approval**, for the next round.

appendices-1.state: {withAppendices} as a draft with two appendices, one published and one never published.
appendices-1.clicks: Open a draft, add two appendices.
callouts: **Edit**, the move up and down arrows, and **Retire** on a row.

appendices-2.state: The appendix page of {withAppendices}, with two published versions and a newer draft.
appendices-2.clicks: Click Edit on Appendix A, save, publish, edit again.
callouts: **Contributors**: everyone who saved or published it.
The back link to the policy draft.

appendices-3.signInAs: Bob and Alice, in two browsers
appendices-3.state: Two browsers (Bob and Alice) have the same appendix open; each sees Editing together and the other cursor.
appendices-3.clicks: Open the same appendix in both.
callouts: Who else is editing, by name. Their cursor shows in the text with their name.

library-1.state: A category exists; the Definitions page has a category chosen and the New definition form open, empty.
library-1.clicks: Structure, Definitions, choose a category, New definition.
callouts: The **Category** chooser. Definitions belong to a category.

library-2.state: {linked}: a draft with a definition, a related policy, a reference and a contact already attached, and the Add controls visible.
library-2.clicks: Scroll below the editor after Alice created items.
callouts: The remove (X) button, and on references and contacts the up and down arrows.

library-3.state: {linked} published, read as Erin; the Related, Definitions, References and Contacts tabs each hold something.
library-3.clicks: Open the published document, click each tab.
callouts: The **Contacts** tab, with department, email and phone.

reading-and-history-1.state: {published} published with a table of contents, a details block and two appendices.
reading-and-history-1.clicks: Open a published policy with an appendix.
callouts: The **On this page** outline. Click a heading to jump to it.
The tabs: **View**, one for each kind of link, and **Changes**.
The appendices, listed at the end of the outline.

reading-and-history-2.state: {twoVersions}: two published versions with visible changes between them.
reading-and-history-2.clicks: Needs two published versions. Click the Changes tab.
callouts: The two version pickers, from the older version to the newer.
The legend: added text is marked new, removed text is marked old.
A bar such as "2 unchanged sections"; press it to show them.

reading-and-history-3.state: {published}; Actions menu open, Print / Export dialog open.
callouts: The "Print this version" dialog. Open it with **Print / Export** in the **Actions** menu.

reading-and-history-4.state: {ack}: a policy that asks Erin to acknowledge and she has not yet; the dialog is open, not confirmed.
reading-and-history-4.clicks: Open a published policy that asks for acknowledgement, click Acknowledge.
callouts: The "Acknowledge this policy?" dialog. Open it with **Acknowledge** on the "Please review and confirm" card.
Your name, the version and the time. They are recorded against your name.

reading-and-history-5.state: {twoVersions}: History & approvals open, with several events.
callouts: The versions, newest first, each with its status.
An event: what happened, and when.

admin-1.state: A category with a default template that is not locked.
admin-1.clicks: Categories, Directory, pick a category with a default template.
callouts: The category tree on the left, with **Filter categories**.
**Default template**, and the **Authors must use this template** tick box that locks it.

admin-2.state: A template with a draft version open: sections with required switches.
admin-2.clicks: Structure, Templates, open a template, Create version.

admin-3.state: A workflow with two stages, one with a quorum, and Allow veto approvers visible.
callouts: **Allow veto approvers**, and who may veto.

admin-4.state: Access for a category with a few Allow and Deny rows and the Simulator open for one person.
admin-4.clicks: Categories, Access, choose a category, open the Simulator.
callouts: **Read** for a person or group: **Allow**, **Deny** or blank.
The **Simulator**: pick a person and see what they can do before you save.

admin-5.state: Users & roles lists the eight test people with roles and groups.

editor-1.state: Editor Tour draft; select a phrase in a paragraph; the toolbar appears.
editor-1.clicks: Editor Tour draft; select a phrase in a paragraph; the toolbar appears.
callouts: **Rework selected text with AI**, when AI is on.

editor-2.state: {draft}: click the empty line under Policy statement and type /; the menu is open.
editor-2.clicks: Editor Tour draft; click the empty last line, press the plus button area and type / so the menu is open.
callouts: A block's name. Type `/` then a few letters of it to find it.

editor-3.state: Editor Tour draft with a callout, an open toggle, a button and a divider in view.
editor-3.clicks: Editor Tour draft with a callout, an open toggle, a button and a divider in view.

editor-4.state: Editor Tour draft with a table; the cursor in a cell so the table toolbar shows and a range of cells selected.
editor-4.clicks: Editor Tour draft with a table; the cursor in a cell so the table toolbar shows and a range of cells selected.
callouts: The table, drawn with a dashed grid while you write and a solid one for the reader.
The table toolbar above it: **Row**, **Column**, **Cell**, **Colour**, **Align**, **Width**, **Size**, **Borders**, **Style**, **Caption** and **Delete table**.

editor-5.state: Editor Tour draft with an image (alt text and caption) selected so its settings show, and a file block.
editor-5.clicks: Editor Tour draft with an image (alt text and caption) selected so its settings show, and a file block.
callouts: An **Image**, with its caption and alt text.
The image's toolbar: regular, wide and full width, and a link. The **Alt** button by the caption sets the alt text.
A **File**, with its title, name and size. A description shows under the title when you add one.

editor-6.state: Editor Tour draft; Cmd+F open with a search that has several matches and the replace box showing.
editor-6.clicks: Editor Tour draft; Cmd+F open with a search that has several matches and the replace box showing.
callouts: **Previous** and **Next** (the up and down arrows), and the count, such as "1 of 14".
The replace box, with **Replace** and **Replace all**.
The list of shortcuts, in groups: **Text**, **Blocks**, **Alignment** and **General**, with the keys for your computer.

editor-8.state: Document in review; some text selected; the toolbar shows only Comment.
editor-8.clicks: Document in review; some text selected; the toolbar shows only Comment.
callouts: The toolbar, with **Comment** and nothing else.

approvals-6.state: {inReview} awaiting Charlie; scrolled to the decision area; nothing typed.
callouts: The **Decision comment** box. A comment is required to approve, reject or send comments.

search-1.state: Bob has opened two documents from the command bar, so Recent has entries.
search-1.clicks: Press Ctrl+K (Cmd+K on a Mac) with nothing typed.
callouts: The **Search** field in the header, with its **Cmd+K** key hint. Click it, or press the shortcut, to open the command bar.
The **Search Steward** box. Type here; **Esc** closes the bar.
**Actions**: what you can do on the page you are on, with the key for each.
**Create**: **New policy**, **New procedure** and **New draft from a template**.
**Recent**: documents you opened from the command bar before.

search-2.state: Bob has typed supplier in the command bar.
callouts: What you typed. Clear it with the **x** at the right.
**Policies** that match, with the document number and category under each title.
**See all results for ...**, which opens the full Search page.

search-3.state: The command bar opened by Shift+C.
search-3.clicks: Press Shift+C with the cursor not in a field.
callouts: **New** is typed for you, selected, so typing replaces it. Only create actions match.
The **Create** group: what Bob may create.
**New policy**, the first action. Press **Enter** to start it.

search-4.state: Alice reads a published document in the admin app and opens the command bar with nothing typed.
search-4.clicks: Open the document in the admin app, press Ctrl+K.
callouts: **Actions**: the everyday actions for this page.
**Admin**: the admin-only tasks for this page, each marked **Admin**.
**Create**: what an admin may create, starting with **New category**. Scroll the list for the rest.
